In Elf World Adventure 9: Summer Episode, you will enjoy an exciting puzzle-solving process, where each completed puzzle unlocks a new illustration of beautiful elf girls. Simple controls and an intuitive interface make the game accessible to everyone, while the summer atmosphere and relaxing music will help you forget about everyday worries.

notes.title: 👑 Lost Castle is calling you! Demo is now available — don’t miss it!
notes.content:
[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/39781881/3f0963009a9b0f82e84da2aaa300501bd7f86098.png[/img]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3221110/Elf_Adventure_The_Lost_Castle/

[h1][b]DEMO VERSION — What Awaits You?[/b][/h1]

This demo is your first step into a fantasy adventure filled with danger, secrets, and the mysterious halls of an ancient castle. Please note: this is not the final version of the game. The full release will include significantly more content, expanded mechanics, and plenty of surprises we believe you’ll love.

[b]In this demo, you’ll experience:[/b]

[list]
[*] Several carefully designed levels to explore
[*] Dynamic battles against goblins lurking in the shadows
[*] Hidden chests scattered throughout the castle
[*] Freilina’s lost illustrations waiting to be collected
[*] Simple and responsive controls
[*] A cozy yet mysterious atmosphere
[*] Captivating music that deepens the immersion
[/list]

You’ll guide Freilina — a brave elf girl — as she fights enemies, explores ancient corridors, and recovers her illustrations.This is just the beginning. The final version will offer many more levels, new enemies, unique features, and gameplay mechanics that will elevate your experience to a whole new level.

At this stage, the demo will only support the English language. However, the full release will include additional language options, such as [b]Korean, Japanese, Russian, and Simplified Chinese.[/b]

notes.content:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3221110/Elf_Adventure_The_Lost_Castle/

[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/39781881/861b14de407967213449068c62a56eba25394388.png[/img]


[h1]Game Description:[/h1]

The elf Freilina was patrolling long-abandoned territories of the forces of evil when she noticed a mysterious castle with lights glowing in its windows. Who could have taken residence in this cursed place? Bandits? Demons? Or something far worse? Armed with a sword and a bow, she ventures inside to uncover the truth and cleanse the castle of its monstrous inhabitants.


Elf Adventure: The Lost Castle is an atmospheric anime-style adventure where players explore a dark and mysterious castle filled with traps, enemies, and valuable treasures. Navigate through vast halls and eerie corridors, battle goblins and their leaders, and discover hidden treasure chests containing unique illustrations of Freilina.

[h1]Game Features:[/h1]

[list]
[*] Choose your combat style – Use a bow for ranged attacks or a sword for close combat.
[*] Explore the castle – Long corridors, hidden rooms, deadly traps.
[*] Battle goblins – Defeat enemies and face off against their leaders.
[*] Collect treasure chests – Find valuable rewards and gather all of Freilina's illustrations.
[*] Deep atmosphere – A dark fantasy setting full of mysteries and dangers.
[/list]

notes.content:
[img]https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/39781881/d436def978d88d2c6d8b32e613d7e00fc12422b3.png[/img]

NEW GAME - Project: Sword Art! 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2304490/Project_Sword_Art/

Project: Sword Art is a visually stunning, engaging and addictive match-3 game that combines spectacular anime-style artwork, addictive gameplay and an exciting fantasy world. Embark on this magical adventure, defeat seductive girls and amass the largest collection in your gallery.

[img]https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/39781881/825a0b7012085409b655b1841bc63abf2f1e71b1.png[/img]

Project: Sword Art is an enchanting match-3 anime-style game set in a fantasy world filled with magic and wonder. Embark on a fascinating journey through a multitude of unique levels accompanied by beautiful music that enhances the immersive gameplay. Prepare to be enchanted by the stunning illustrations that open up as you progress through the game.

Immerse yourself in magical gameplay as you solve challenging puzzles by matching three or more elements. Strategically swap and match symbols to create powerful combinations that unleash spells and special abilities. The game mechanics are intuitively designed, making for a smooth and immersive experience for players of all skill levels.

[img]https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/39781881/ad671044171b56ba13423bf0c392e46ef1072f0e.png[/img]

In this mesmerizing world, you'll encounter a number of alluring and formidable girls. Engage in exciting battles with them, demonstrating your puzzle-solving skills and strategic thinking. When you emerge victorious, these fascinating girls will become part of your ever-expanding collection in your personal gallery. Collecting all the girls is a delightful challenge.

Throughout your journey, you'll have the opportunity to earn achievements for your successes, such as completing levels or winning challenging battles. Demonstrate your skills and be rewarded for your mastery of the game.

[h1]FEATURES[/h1]

[list]
[*] Incredible visual effects
[*] Amazing hentai scenes
[*] Pass through levels and collect images
[*] Relax to the music during the game
[*] 100+ Achievements
[*] Trade Cards (soon)

[*] Steam Backgrounds (soon)
[*] Enjoy your day with cute girls[/list]

[h1]Project: MIRROR![/h1] is a world full of magic, there souls of beautiful girls have broken into several pieces during a violent and powerful storm. You are the only one who can help the beauties revive their souls!

[h1]GAMEPLAY:[/h1]
Project: MIRROR! is a casual game where you can choose between two worlds where you want to play. The worlds have their own levels and differ in design and gameplay.

In the first world, you have to drag one point to another and form a shape out of all the lines.
The second world has a simple Match-Three type of game where you have to create one line of three or more elements to earn points.

Each world contains many different and interesting levels. You get stars for completing a level. Images will be unlocked after several levels you complete. These images can always be viewed and downloaded in the gallery. The game has a hundred achievements. There is also a button for skipping levels.

[h1]GAME FEATURES:[/h1]


Choose between two different worlds

Pass levels and gain stars

Unlock and collect images

Take 100 achievements

Relax with music while playing

Can skip any level with one-click

Download images from gallery

Enjoy your day with a cute girls!
